title: 애낌 (AEKKIM)
summary: AEKKIM is an Android subscription-management service that analyzes payment history and app usage to recommend benefits and check-in alerts for reducing unnecessary spending. Its AI/data_generator pipeline runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, fit on a real user CSV via a SingleTableMetadata schema, to synthesize additional user transaction records.
